environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.large) running in VPC subnet-0a1b2c3d with NAT gateway for S3 access. Instance role arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/LegacyMonolithRole has s3:PutObject and s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::legacy-app-uploads-prod/*. S3 bucket has no bucket policy restrictions. Traffic to S3 goes through NAT gateway (public internet path). No VPC endpoint configured. Bucket serves content via CloudFront with default cache behavior passing through Content-Type header.

config.s3_access_path: NAT Gateway -> Internet -> S3 public endpoint
